row.title: The directory register route was dead behind the site worker's GET-only gate
row.body: POST /api/directory/register was a case inside the switch that runs after the site worker rejects every non-GET/HEAD with 405, so no seed heartbeat ever reached register() and the directory had 0 external rows. The second live bootaccept run named it (register answered HTTP 405). The route now sits before the gate, a worker-level test POSTs it, and a guard fails any POST branch written after the gate.
row.probe: grep:site/directory.test.mjs::no POST route in the site worker sits after
